pages.title: Ground Truth Feed
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA WEATHER INGEST NODE$()$(br)Monitoring Station Upload Log$(br2)Handshake accepted. Surface observations queued for orbital correction models.$(br2)Priority fields: temperature, wind shear, snowfall rate, atmospheric opacity.$(br2)Civilian operators instructed to maintain hourly submissions until relieved.

pages.title: No Reply
pages.text: Three weeks after the evacuation wave, uploads continue leaving the station with no acknowledgment returning.$(br2)The terminal still accepts packets. ORSA never answers.$(br2)Someone kept logging data long after the network on the other end went silent.
